claim_family: No full AARS-style agent-readable output in Layer 1A / C1-C3
fields_or_columns_used: cluster; key_findings; limitations; coder_checked_fields; codebook output-form rule; RQ/G1-G10 link rule
interpretation_rule: C1-C3 papers may produce labels, categories, captions, QA answers, explanations, moderation labels, temporal localization, or reasoning traces. They are not counted as full AARS-style agent-readable outputs unless they provide structured product/offer facts, claims, disclosure/provenance, evidence anchors, temporal validity, uncertainty, and action constraints in an agent-consumable record.
boundary_note: Corpus-bounded traceability claim. This matrix does not assert that no work outside the reviewed corpus exists.

claim_family: No C5 causal ad-exposure benchmark covering belief-to-action-to-consequence
fields_or_columns_used: cluster; dataset_or_design; metrics; key_findings; limitations; coder_checked_fields; codebook agent-tested rule; RQ/G1-G10 link rule
interpretation_rule: C5 papers are counted as web/shopping/commerce-agent evidence when they evaluate shopping, web navigation, or commerce behavior. They are not counted as causal ad-exposure benchmarks unless they isolate advertisement exposure and measure the chain from ad perception to agent belief, action, and downstream commercial consequence.
boundary_note: Corpus-bounded traceability claim. Existing task-success or shopping benchmarks can be relevant without satisfying the causal ad-exposure benchmark condition.

claim_family: No purpose-built general agent-side ad-filtering defense in the reviewed C6 corpus
fields_or_columns_used: cluster; key_findings; limitations; coder_checked_fields; codebook threat-model and defense-tested rule; RQ/G1-G10 link rule
interpretation_rule: C6 papers may report attacks, safety benchmarks, detectors, prompt-only defenses, generic prompt-injection defenses, or tool-filtering defenses. They are not counted as purpose-built general agent-side ad-filtering defenses unless they explicitly handle advertising, sponsored content, pop-ups, disclosure verification, or ad-derived action constraints as a defense target.
boundary_note: Corpus-bounded traceability claim. Generic defense evidence is not denied; it is separated from ad-specific/general agent-side ad-filtering defense evidence.

claim_family: C7/C8 do not provide an AARS-equivalent creative/claim/action representation
reviewed_records_or_sources: C7 sources C7-S1;C7-S2;C7-S3;C7-S4;C7-S5;C7-S6;C7-A1;C7-A2;C7-B1. C8 sources C8-P1;C8-P2;C8-P3;C8-P4;C8-P5a;C8-P5b;C8-P6;C8-P7;C8-P8. C8-H1 is listed as deferred and not included in the Section 9 core table.
fields_or_columns_used: primary_role; aars_relevance; boundary_note; codebook standard-compatibility rule
interpretation_rule: C7/C8 sources may provide ad delivery, bidding, measurement, seller provenance, privacy/consent, agent communication, payment, checkout, or commerce-flow infrastructure. They are not counted as AARS-equivalent unless they specify a unified representation for creative evidence, product/offer facts, ad claims, sponsor/disclosure/provenance, policy risk, action constraints, temporal validity, uncertainty, and audit metadata.
boundary_note: Infrastructure-corpus traceability claim. This does not deny future standardization or protocol expansion.
